name: ai.wakeagents/site-readiness
title: Wake site readiness
description: How an AI agent sees a public website: robots, llms.txt, sitemap, agent card, scored. No key needed.

tools.name: wake_check_site
tools.description: Probe a public hostname the way an AI agent sees it (homepage, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap, agent card) and return scores out of 100 with concrete recommendations and publish-ready llms.txt / robots files. Input is a hostname only; the probe keeps structural signals, never page bodies. No account needed.

tools.name: wake_signup
tools.description: Opens the Wake desk for a website you own and returns everything needed to finish setup in one call: the desk URL, an API key, the MCP endpoint and the next steps (wake_provision for the tracker file, wake_verify to prove the site, wake_fix_plan for what to change). 7-day trial, no card, no browser; watching the agents and the loss count stay free for good after it. Use it when the site's owner asked you to set up Wake, or after wake_check_site showed problems worth fixing on a site you work for. Needs site, email and terms_accepted: true (terms: /wake/docs/terms.md, privacy: /wake/docs/privacy.md). One desk per host; the owner can invite you to an existing one.

email.description: The owner's email; the desk sign-in link and the weekly brief go there.

terms_accepted.description: true once the Terms and Privacy policy are accepted on the owner's behalf.

source.description: Optional: where you found Wake (mcp, docs, score).

tools.name: wake_about
tools.description: One paragraph on Wake (agent experience optimization and agent engine optimization for a website), with links to docs, API, MCP and signup.
